mkdir -p /tmp/sections && cd /tmp/resized && for f in *.png; do
  name="${f%.png}"
  height=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$f")
  parts=$(( (height + 1799) / 1800 ))
  for ((i=0; i<parts; i++)); do
    y=$((i*1800))
    ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1000:1800:0:$y" "/tmp/sections/${name}_${i}.png" 2>/dev/null
  done
done && ls /tmp/sections/

A light-filled open-plan kitchen, meals and family room opens onto the deep north-facing rear garden — perfect for entertaining year-round. Stone benchtops, integrated Miele appliances and a butler's pantry complete the chef's kitchen.

Four generous bedrooms include a sumptuous main with walk-in robe and ensuite. Zoning to Auburn High and walking distance to Glenferrie Road shops, cafés and Hawthorn Station make this an exceptional family opportunity.

All five pages have been written to `/app/site/`. Each is a self-contained HTML file with inline CSS (Inter via Google Fonts) — no external images, no JS frameworks.

Design highlights replicated across pages:
- **PropertyNest brand**: teal primary (`#0d7373`), orange accent (`#ed6431`), and a square logo mark with a small orange dot
- **Shared chrome**: header with logo + nav, subnav tabs, dark teal footer with 5-column link grid
- **home.html**: gradient hero with search, featured suburb cards, auction results table with colored pill clearances, snapshot cards, buyer-guide tiles, news grid, Coburg suburb spotlight, app CTA with QR
- **agents.html**: filtered agent cards with avatars, leaderboard sidebar with rank badges, peach "Selling soon?" CTA, suburb medians, big appraisal-form CTA
- **listing.html**: photo gallery mosaic, price + features, auction banner, description with checkmark feature list, hand-built SVG floorplan with compass, suburb stats block, schools/transport columns, sticky agent enquiry sidebar
- **search.html**: filter sidebar with range slider/pill buttons/checkboxes, property card grid with colored gradient images and status pills, embedded suburb-median banner, pagination row
- **suburb.html**: hero with stat strip, SVG line chart (houses vs units) with legend, demographic donut charts via conic-gradient, schools map with absolutely-positioned pins, recent-sales table, "for sale now" cards
